description.description: One line on what the workflow does.

subject.description: The unit provider the workflow matches; its facts are in that provider's slot.

trigger.description: Exactly one of every, on or schedule.

every.description: Evaluated on every sweep against every unit of the provider.

on.description: Source event kinds; the workflow reads each event once.

schedule.description: Five-field cron in local time, such as "0 9 * * 1-5".

when.description: A predicate over the subject's slot, trigger.* and config.*. Write it before the [trigger] table.

step.description: Builtins run in order on each matching unit; the other keys of a step are its arguments, all strings.

per_run.description: Items that run in one evaluation; 0 is no limit.

per_day.description: Runs per day; 0 is no limit. Required, above 0, for a workflow that starts turns on units other than pull requests.

per_unit_per_day.description: Runs per unit per day; 0 is no limit.

cooldown.description: The least time between runs, such as 30m or 1d.

mode.description: observe writes only the plan; apply runs the steps. Default apply.

allow_visible.description: Opts the workflow's visible steps into automatic.

order.description: Evaluation order among workflows on the same trigger, lower first. Default 100.

key.description: Stable facts of the subject's slot that make the idempotency key. Default is the slot's fingerprint.

marks.description: Marks a done or dismissed run records on its unit: each name, stored as <workflow>/<name>, takes the value of a string, time or int fact of the subject's slot as planned. handled("<workflow>/<name>", <fact>) reads it back.

default.description: What happens when the window ends: run, or wait for the user. Default run.

window.description: How long the user has to act, such as 5m. Without one, a default run item runs at once.

wait_when.description: A predicate over the same slots as when; a match makes the item pending with default wait.

draft_approval.description: When the drafts this workflow proposes, and those of the turns it starts, are sent without the user's click. Absent: always. The approval block above governs runs, never drafts.

mode.description: always: the user approves each draft; window: sent when the window ends unless the user discards or edits it first; none: sent at once; observe: recorded, never sent.

window.description: With mode window only: how long the user has, such as 10m.

rule.description: Rules tried in order before mode; the first whose when holds gives the mode. A rule that sends on its own (none or window) applies to a comment draft only when its when has draft.delivery == "comment" as a term of its top-level &&.

when.description: A predicate over draft.delivery, draft.proposer, draft.effects, draft.purpose (empty for a turn's draft) and the subject's facts.

mode.description: The mode of a draft the rule matches.

window.description: With mode window only: how long the user has, such as 10m.

withdraw.description: When an open draft the workflow proposed is withdrawn.

when.description: A predicate over the subject's facts and draft.*; a match withdraws the draft.

reason.description: The withdrawn draft's reason: assigned (its items got an owner) or moot, the default.

auto_send.description: Replaced by [draft_approval]; loads with a warning: false is read as mode always with no rules, true as nothing.
